decision.reopen_trigger: A BLS correction, a published September CPI result with an independently reported fact and a distinct non-directional retail calculation path, or a current public English question that requests materially different fixed-risk inputs; otherwise retire this result-day frame after September 6 ET.
decision.rationale: BLS and AP are independent reliable publishers for the same-day August result, while BabyPips establishes current FX-audience discovery wording. The published +162,000 / 4.1% / +55,000 result replaces the old July -23,000 / 4.1% / -103,000 fact set; the result-first query object, USD 50 20/40/80-pip teaching table, and post-release window make all four refresh signals true. This refresh updates the existing payroll fixed-risk article, not a new macro article, and makes no currency, Fed, market, volatility, or execution claim.
